картина: Официальная лента release notes Vertex AI (Google Cloud Documentation), сводная по четырём продуктам: Agent Platform Workbench (бывш. Vertex AI Workbench / AI Platform Notebooks), Colab Enterprise, Generative AI on Vertex AI и Vertex AI (платформа). Период — от March 01, 2019 до September 21, 2026, 458 датированных записей в обратном хронологическом порядке; внутри записи — блоки продукта с версией API (v1/v2/v1beta1) и типом (Feature/Change/Deprecated/Announcement/Fixed/Security/Breaking). Большая часть объёма — повторяющиеся релизы образов Workbench («Installed latest packages from upstream dependencies», одни и те же фиксы по 2-4 раза), где «image» — образ ВМ/контейнера. Про генерацию картинок — 35 записей: жизненный цикл Imagen 1-4 (GA, превью, доступ по одобрению, SynthID по умолчанию, соотношения сторон, inpainting/outpainting/product editing, кастомизация по рефам, prompt rewriter, депрекейты), Virtual Try-On, Gemini-картинки (2.0 Flash image generation preview, 2.5 Flash Image preview→GA, 3.1 Flash Image public preview с рекомендацией Google) и сторонние image-модели Model Garden (Stable Diffusion, Flux, HiDream-I1, Qwen-Image и др.). Сквозной сюжет 2025-2026: всё семейство Imagen (включая Imagen 4 GA, кастомизацию и редактирование) уводится на gemini-2.5-flash-image, а отдельно Google рекомендует 3.1 Flash Image для генерации. Правил промптинга почти нет — есть только описание встроенного переписчика промптов Imagen 3. Nano Banana Pro (gemini-3-pro-image) и Nano Banana 2 Lite в ленте отсутствуют. После May 26, 2026 записей Generative AI нет — только Workbench; вверху баннер: документация Vertex AI больше не обновляется, сервисы переехали в Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. По метаданным партии записи о генеративном ИИ дословно дублируют отдельную ленту Generative AI on Vertex AI release notes (id48); здесь это не сверялось.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Gemini 2.0 Flash image output on this page: multimodal outputs only in private preview when 2.0 Flash went GA for text (2025-02-05), public preview of gemini-2.0-flash-preview-image-generation (2025-05-07), then deprecation of the preview endpoint (written gemini-2.0-flash-image-generation-preview) with gemini-2.5-flash-image as replacement and a 2026-03-19 deadline (2026-02-17).

Imagen 1/2 lifecycle on this page: imagegeneration@005 becomes GA and the default (2023-12-13), imagegeneration@006 adds editing, aspect ratios and default SynthID (2024-04-09), the imagegeneration@00x models remain approval-gated after Imagen 3 opens to all (2024-12-10), are deprecated on 2025-06-24 with removal on 2025-09-24, yet reappear in the 2026-03-24 deprecation table with a June 30, 2026 target.

Imagen 3 lifecycle on this page: GA for approved users (2024-07-31), GA for all users plus the imagen-3.0-capability customization and editing model (2024-12-10), imagen-3.0-generate-002 with prompt enhancement (2025-01-29), and deprecation of all Imagen 3 endpoints in favour of gemini-2.5-flash-image (2026-03-24).

Imagen 4 lifecycle on this page: Preview 05-20 models (2025-05-20), replaced by 06-06 previews with a 2025-07-07 migration deadline (2025-06-11), GA of Generate/Fast/Ultra (2025-08-14), preview removal set for 2025-11-30 (2025-10-14), preview endpoints listed as deprecated with a 2026-03-19 deadline (2026-02-17), and the GA models themselves deprecated in favour of gemini-2.5-flash-image (2026-03-24), about seven months after GA.

Virtual Try-On lifecycle on this page: Preview (2025-08-06, entry flagged as incorrect), quality updates (2025-09-15, 2025-09-30 reported on 2025-10-09, 2025-12-16), GA as virtual-try-on-001 (2026-01-23) and deprecation of the preview endpoint (2026-02-17); virtual-try-on-001 is the only Imagen-family image product not redirected to Gemini in the 2026-03-24 table.

Subject/style personalisation moves across the page from Imagen tuning (restricted GA, 2023-08-29) to Imagen 3 Customization with few-shot reference images (2024-12-10), to Gemini 2.5 Flash Image with multi-reference generation (2025-08-26, 2025-10-02) recommended as the replacement when Imagen tuning is removed (2025-10-14), and the capability endpoints are redirected to gemini-2.5-flash-image (2026-03-24).

Mask-based editing (inpainting, outpainting, product image editing) is listed for imagegeneration@006 (2024-04-09) and Imagen 3 Editing (2024-12-10); for Gemini image models the page only mentions improved multi-turn image editing (2025-08-26, 2025-10-02), yet Imagen edit and product-recontext previews are redirected to gemini-2.5-flash-image (2026-02-17).

SynthID watermarking, watermark verification and person/face safety settings are documented on this page only for Imagen (imagegeneration@006 and Imagen 3); the page says nothing about watermarking or safety settings for Gemini image models.

The only explicit aspect-ratio list on the page is 1:1, 3:4, 4:3, 9:16 and 16:9 (imagegeneration@006 and Imagen 3); Gemini 2.5 Flash Image GA only mentions 'aspect ratio controls' without listing values.

Access gating relaxes over time: Imagen generation/editing and tuning start as restricted access (2023-07-17, 2023-08-29), Imagen 3 goes from approved users (2024-07-31) to all users (2024-12-10) while customization, editing and older imagegeneration models stay approval-gated; no approval requirement is mentioned for any Gemini image model.

Third-party image generation/editing models appear in Model Garden throughout the page (Stable Diffusion 1.5/2.1/XL, LCM, SDXL-Turbo, SDXL LCM, Lama, instruct-pix2pix, Instant ID, SDXL lightning, SD 2.1, Flux, HiDream-I1, Qwen-Image/-Edit); none of them is deprecated on the page and none comes with prompting guidance.
